caption: Bold white text on a black bar at the top reads a teacher's announcement. Below it, a large photo shows a man visibly sweating, with beads of sweat on his face, looking anxious off-camera.
ocr_text: TEACHER: YOU'LL NOW SUBMIT ASSIGNMENTS THROUGH AN AI CHECKER.
joke_summary: Students who used AI to write their assignments panic when told submissions will be screened by an AI detection tool.
